subject: Coord: Hosted API invoke pipeline + SDK streaming architecture deep-dive
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@medinex.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API invoke pipeline + SDK streaming architecture deep-dive — proposed slots

Hi Sara,

Thanks again for the time on Wednesday. To make progress on the integration we recommended a focused architecture deep-dive to cover the invoke/streaming patterns, SDK usage, and how function/tool-calling fits into your event pipeline. Goal: leave with a concrete integration plan and a small mutual action list.

Proposed scope (60–90 minutes):
- Quick context (5–10m): production goals & traffic patterns
- SDK streaming + continuous batching patterns (20m)
- Function/tool calling / structured outputs for triage flows (20m)
- KV/prefix caching and latency trade-offs (10m)
- Rollout/checklist & next steps (10–20m)

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Aug 18, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Aug 19, 13:00–14:30
- Thu Aug 20, 09:30–11:00

If none work, share a couple of windows and we’ll flex. Can you also confirm the technical attendees on your side (recommended: backend lead, infra/ops)? I’ll loop in our integration engineer and CS rep.

I attached a short pre-call questionnaire to capture traffic patterns and current SDK usage — filling it out ahead of time will help us optimize the agenda.

Thanks,
Rafael
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132
Attachments: medinex-precall-questions.pdf

From: Sara Li <sara.li@medinex.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@medinex.com
Date: 2026-08-14T12:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API invoke pipeline + SDK streaming architecture deep-dive — proposed slots

Hi Rafael,

Thanks — this looks great. We definitely want the backend lead (I’ll invite Tom, our backend eng manager) and our platform ops (cc’d ops@medinex.com). One constraint: we have a compliance review the afternoon of the 18th, so that first slot is tough. Our preferred windows (PT) are:
- Wed Aug 19, 14:00–15:30 (we can extend 30m if needed)
- Thu Aug 20, 10:00–11:30

Are you able to include a short section on data retention & audit logging for streaming requests? Also, can your engineer speak to on-prem VPC/private deployment options briefly — our security team will be listening in.

I’ll try to fill the pre-call questionnaire by EOD Monday.

Best,
Sara Li
Senior Product Manager — Medinex Health
sara.li@medinex.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-14T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API invoke pipeline + SDK streaming architecture deep-dive — Medinex availability (please advise)

Team — forwarding Sara’s reply. Can you confirm who can join and what material we should bring? Key asks from Medinex: data retention/audit logging, on-prem/VPC options, and a deep discussion on streaming batching and function/tool calling.

Suggested attendee roles:
- Grace: CS lead to own rollout/checklist and runbook items
- Karthik: Integration engineer — streaming + SDK patterns + demo snippet
- Lauren: Solutions / security liaison — VPC/KMS overview and compliance hooks

Available windows they like: Wed Aug 19 14:00–15:30 PT or Thu Aug 20 10:00–11:30 PT. If we pick Wed 19 at 14:00PT, I’ll send the calendar invite and attach the runbook draft for discussion.

Also — Karthik, could you draft a 10–12 minute demo snippet that shows: SDK stream init, partial response handling, and a function call to a mocked downstream triage service? Keep it runnable in ~10 mins.

Rafael

Agenda (final):
1) 5–10m: goals & production context (Sara/Tom)
2) 20m: SDK streaming & continuous batching patterns (Karthik)
3) 15m: Function/tool calling for triage + demo snippet (Karthik + Grace)
4) 15m: Data retention, audit logging, and on-prem/VPC considerations (Lauren)
5) 10–20m: Rollout checklist, runbook walkthrough, next steps (Grace + Rafa)

Prep: Sara — thanks for committing to the pre-call questionnaire. We’ll circulate the runbook + diagram ahead of time. Links and attachments below.

Zoom: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/9876543210

See you Wed — I’ll share notes and the recording afterward.

Rafael

Perfect — thanks Rafael. Tom and ops will join. Two small asks before Wed:
- Could we add a 5 minute demo of request-level audit logs showing a tracing id/retention lifecycle?

If you can add those bullets to the runbook before the call that would be ideal. See you Wednesday.

Sara
